name: Narmada Macplast Drip Irrigation Systems Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, Narmada 
Macplast Drip Irrigation Systems 
Ltd is in business of drip irrigation 
system[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
a) Import-Export, Consultancy of the
Plastic products and Raw materials, Govt. 
Supplies and liaison work.
b) Suppliers of drip, sprinkler & land scape 
garden irrigation equipment, and other related products.

cons: Stock is trading at 9.94 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 12.0% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.40% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.62 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 152 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -40.1%
